docs.title: Introduction to Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics
docs.description: Welcome to the comprehensive 13-week course for industry practitioners. Learn to build intelligent robotic systems that perceive, plan, and interact with the physical world.

frontMatter.title: Introduction to Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics
frontMatter.description: Welcome to the comprehensive 13-week course for industry practitioners. Learn to build intelligent robotic systems that perceive, plan, and interact with the physical world.
learning_objectives: Explain the concept of Physical AI and how it differs from traditional AI
Identify the four core components of Physical AI systems (perception, planning, action, learning)
Describe the course structure and progression through 4 modules over 13 weeks
Select the appropriate hardware setup path for your learning environment

docs.title: Chapter 1: Introduction to ROS 2
docs.description: Understand the distributed architecture of ROS 2, explore nodes, topics, services, and the computational graph model for robotic systems

frontMatter.title: Chapter 1: Introduction to ROS 2
frontMatter.description: Understand the distributed architecture of ROS 2, explore nodes, topics, services, and the computational graph model for robotic systems
learning_objectives: Understand the distributed architecture of ROS 2 and how it differs from ROS 1
Apply node concepts to design modular robotic systems
Demonstrate knowledge of topics, services, and actions communication patterns
Evaluate which ROS 2 distribution to use for specific platforms

docs.title: Chapter 2: ROS 2 Nodes and Topics
docs.description: Master rclpy programming by building publishers, subscribers, and understanding Quality of Service for reliable robot communication

frontMatter.title: Chapter 2: ROS 2 Nodes and Topics
frontMatter.description: Master rclpy programming by building publishers, subscribers, and understanding Quality of Service for reliable robot communication
learning_objectives: Implement ROS 2 nodes using rclpy library and the Node class
Create publishers and subscribers to exchange messages between nodes
Apply Quality of Service (QoS) policies to configure reliable communication
Demonstrate debugging skills using ROS 2 introspection tools

docs.title: Chapter 3: Services, Actions, and Parameters
docs.description: Master request-response services, long-running actions, and runtime parameters to build sophisticated robotic behaviors

frontMatter.title: Chapter 3: Services, Actions, and Parameters
frontMatter.description: Master request-response services, long-running actions, and runtime parameters to build sophisticated robotic behaviors
learning_objectives: Implement service servers and clients for request-response communication
Create action servers and clients for long-running tasks with feedback
Apply parameters for runtime configuration of nodes
Design AI-ROS integration patterns separating decision logic from communication

docs.title: Chapter 4: URDF Robot Modeling
docs.description: Learn to define robot structure using URDF with links, joints, visual geometry, and kinematic chains for simulation and control

frontMatter.title: Chapter 4: URDF Robot Modeling
frontMatter.description: Learn to define robot structure using URDF with links, joints, visual geometry, and kinematic chains for simulation and control
learning_objectives: Create URDF files defining robot links, joints, and kinematic chains
Apply visual and collision geometry for robot visualization and physics
Design humanoid robot models with proper joint hierarchies and naming conventions
Evaluate URDF models using check_urdf and visualize in RViz2

docs.title: Chapter 5: Launch Files and Package Management
docs.description: Master ROS 2 package structure, Python launch files, and colcon build system to deploy multi-node robotic applications

frontMatter.title: Chapter 5: Launch Files and Package Management
frontMatter.description: Master ROS 2 package structure, Python launch files, and colcon build system to deploy multi-node robotic applications
learning_objectives: Create Python launch files to manage multi-node systems with parameters and remapping
Build ROS 2 packages with proper directory structure and dependency management
Apply colcon build system to compile and install packages in workspaces
Design reusable packages following ROS 2 conventions and best practices

docs.title: Module 1: The Robotic Nervous System (ROS 2)
docs.description: Master ROS 2 architecture, communication patterns, and robot modeling to build distributed robotic systems

frontMatter.title: Module 1: The Robotic Nervous System (ROS 2)
frontMatter.description: Master ROS 2 architecture, communication patterns, and robot modeling to build distributed robotic systems
learning_objectives: Explain the ROS 2 computation graph and its components (nodes, topics, services, actions)
Create publishers, subscribers, and service clients using rclpy
Define robot structure using URDF and visualize in RViz2
Launch multi-node systems and debug distributed applications
Build a complete ROS 2 package with proper package structure

docs.title: Module 2: Digital Twins - Simulation & Sensors
docs.description: Build digital twins for robotic systems using Gazebo and Unity to simulate sensors, physics, and environments

frontMatter.title: Module 2: Digital Twins - Simulation & Sensors
frontMatter.description: Build digital twins for robotic systems using Gazebo and Unity to simulate sensors, physics, and environments
learning_objectives: Create Gazebo simulation environments with physics engines and sensor models
Integrate Unity for photorealistic sensor simulation using Unity Robotics Hub
Test navigation and perception algorithms in simulation before hardware deployment
Bridge simulated and real robot workflows for seamless sim-to-real transfer

frontMatter.title: Module 3: NVIDIA Isaac - Perception & Navigation
frontMatter.description: Leverage NVIDIA Isaac Sim for GPU-accelerated robotics with VSLAM, Nav2 navigation, and reinforcement learning
learning_objectives: Set up and configure NVIDIA Isaac Sim environments with RTX-accelerated rendering
Implement Visual SLAM (VSLAM) for robot localization and mapping
Deploy Nav2 navigation stack for autonomous navigation with dynamic obstacles
Train reinforcement learning policies using Isaac Gym for manipulation tasks

docs.title: Module 4: VLA & Humanoid Robotics
docs.description: Integrate Vision-Language-Action models with humanoid robots for natural human-robot interaction and manipulation

frontMatter.title: Module 4: VLA & Humanoid Robotics
frontMatter.description: Integrate Vision-Language-Action models with humanoid robots for natural human-robot interaction and manipulation
learning_objectives: Calculate forward and inverse kinematics for humanoid robots with 30+ degrees of freedom
Implement manipulation primitives (reach, grasp, place) for pick-and-place tasks
Integrate conversational AI (speech-to-text, LLMs) with robot action planning
Deploy end-to-end VLA systems that translate voice commands into physical actions
